question: Depression is not a side effect of
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Propranolol" -> "commonly used for anxiety" -> "not typically associated with depression" -> 85%
CHAIN: "Oral contraceptives" -> "hormonal changes can affect mood" -> "some may experience depression" -> "not a common side effect" -> 70%

analysis: Propranolol (opa) is a beta-blocker primarily used for hypertension and anxiety, and while it can have some mood-related side effects, depression is not commonly associated with it. Oral contraceptives (opb) can have mood changes, including depression, in some users. Reserpine (opc) is known to cause depression as a side effect due to its action on monoamine neurotransmitters. Flupenthixol (opd) is an antipsychotic that can also lead to depressive symptoms. Therefore, the least likely to cause depression is Propranolol.
